programme.desc: At a remote forest cabin, five friends discover a Book of the Dead and unwittingly summon an ancient demon. The malevolent entity possesses each person in succession, until only one is left intact to fight for survival.

programme.title: Evil Dead Rise
programme.desc: A reunion between two estranged sisters gets cut short by the rise of flesh-possessing demons, thrusting them into a primal battle for survival as they face the most nightmarish version of family imaginable.

programme.title: Evil Dead Burn
programme.desc: After the loss of her husband, a grieving woman seeks solace with her in-laws at their secluded family home. However, it soon becomes a reunion from hell as the Book of the Dead unleashes demonic forces that transform them into Deadites one by one.

programme.title: The Strangers: Chapter 1
programme.desc: After their car breaks down in an eerie small town, a young couple is forced to spend the night in a remote cabin. Panic ensues as they are terrorized by three masked strangers who strike with no mercy and seemingly no motive.

programme.title: Pearl
programme.desc: Trapped on an isolated farm, Pearl must tend to her ailing father under the watch of her mother. Lusting for the glamorous life she's seen in movies, Pearl's temptations and repressions collide.

programme.title: MaXXXine
programme.desc: Aspiring movie star and hustler Maxine Minx finally gets her big break. But as a mysterious killer stalks the starlets of 1980s Hollywood, a trail of blood threatens to reveal her sinister past.

programme.title: Les Misérables
programme.desc: In 19th-century France, ex-prisoner Jean Valjean (Hugh Jackman), pursued for many years by ruthless policeman Javert (Russell Crowe), agrees to care for a factory worker's daughter.

programme.title: City Dump: The Story of the 1951 CCNY Basketball Scandal
programme.desc: TV footage, home movies and interviews chronicle the game-fixing scandal at the City College of New York.

programme.title: Shot Heard 'Round the World
programme.desc: Bobby Thomson's dramatic home run ends the 1951 National League baseball playoff between the New York Giants and the Brooklyn Dodgers.

programme.title: Magnolia
programme.desc: Coincidence, divine intervention and fate link several people (Jason Robards, Julianne Moore, Tom Cruise) on an intense day which becomes a moral odyssey.

programme.title: Eyes Wide Shut
programme.desc: A doctor (Tom Cruise) explores his relationship with his wife (Nicole Kidman) by delving into a sensual underworld.

programme.title: American Made
programme.desc: The true story of pilot Barry Seal, who transported contraband for the CIA and the Medellín cartel in the 1980s.

programme.title: The Age of Adaline
programme.desc: A woman who has miraculously remained young for nearly 80 years meets a charismatic philanthropist who reawakens her passion for life and romance.

programme.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
programme.desc: Twentieth-century teenagers (Leonardo DiCaprio, Claire Danes) fall in love, despite feuding families, in an update of the classic tragedy.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Emily Brontë's gothic heroine Cathy (Merle Oberon) loves stable boy Heathcliff (Laurence Olivier) but marries squire Edgar (David Niven).

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their Mississippi hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: Survivors (Woody Harrelson, Jesse Eisenberg, Emma Stone) of a zombie apocalypse use creative means to dispatch the undead as they make their way toward a rumored safe haven in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Zombieland: Double Tap
programme.desc: Post-apocalyptic warriors Tallahassee, Columbus, Wichita and Little Rock must rely on their wits and weapons more than ever as they find themselves in a relentless battle against smarter, faster and seemingly indestructible zombies.

programme.title: Undertone
programme.desc: The host of a popular paranormal podcast is sent hidden messages within anonymous recordings, unleashing a demonic presence that is impossible to escape.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
programme.desc: After reuniting with Gwen Stacy, Brooklyn's full-time, friendly neighborhood Spider-Man is catapulted across the Multiverse, where he encounters a team of Spider-People charged with protecting its very existence.

programme.title: Diego Maradona
programme.desc: On July 5, 1984, Diego Maradona arrives in Naples for a world-record fee. The world's most celebrated soccer icon and the most passionate but dangerous city in Europe are a perfect match for each other.

programme.title: Magic & Bird: A Courtship of Rivals
programme.desc: A history traces the competition between basketball players Larry Bird and Earvin "Magic" Johnson.

programme.title: Gran Turismo
programme.desc: The true story of a team of unlikely underdogs -- a working-class gamer, a former race car driver, and an idealistic motorsport executive -- who risk it all to take on the most elite sport in the world.

programme.title: The Last Samurai
programme.desc: In the 1870s a Westerner is caught in the middle of a battle between Japan's emperor and the samurai.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: A New Jersey man (Tom Cruise) and his two children face an epic battle for survival when hostile aliens invade Earth.

programme.title: The Revenant
programme.desc: In 1823, fur trapper Hugh Glass (Leonardo DiCaprio) treks through the snowy wilderness to track down John Fitzgerald (Tom Hardy), a member of his hunting team who killed his young son (Forrest Goodluck) and left him for dead.

programme.title: Greenland
programme.desc: A family embarks on a perilous journey as a planet-killing comet hurtles toward Earth. As the countdown to the global apocalypse approaches zero, their incredible trek culminates in a desperate and last-minute flight to a possible safe haven.

programme.title: Greenland 2: Migration
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a comet strike that decimated most of the planet, the Garrity family must leave the safety of their Greenland bunker to traverse a shattered world in search of a new home.

programme.title: The Housemaid
programme.desc: Hoping for a fresh start, a young woman becomes a live-in maid for a wealthy couple who harbor sinister secrets.

programme.title: Saltburn
programme.desc: A student is invited to an eccentric classmate's estate for an exciting summer.

programme.title: The Perfect Weapon
programme.desc: An exploration of the rise of cyber conflict as the primary way that nations now compete with and sabotage one another; interviews with top military, intelligence and political officials; includes on-the-ground reporting from the front lines.

programme.title: Kill Chain: The Cyber War on America's Elections
programme.desc: From voter registration to counting ballots, data security expert Harri Hursti examines how hackers can influence and disrupt the U.S. election system.

programme.title: The Insurrectionist Next Door
programme.desc: Alexandra Pelosi turns her camera on people who stormed the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021; through interviews conducted over two years, Pelosi talks to individuals charged with crimes for their participation in the unprecedented events of the day.

programme.title: Batman Begins
programme.desc: Following the death of his parents, young heir Bruce Wayne (Christian Bale) becomes a masked avenger who fights the forces of evil in Gotham City.

programme.title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
programme.desc: Convinced that Superman (Henry Cavill) is now a threat to humanity, Batman (Ben Affleck) embarks on a personal vendetta to end his reign on Earth, while the conniving Lex Luthor (Jesse Eisenberg) launches his own crusade against the Man of Steel.

programme.title: The Batman
programme.desc: Batman ventures into Gotham City's underworld when a sadistic killer leaves behind a trail of cryptic clues. As the scale of the perpetrator's plans become clear, he must bring justice to the abuse of power and corruption that plagues the metropolis.

programme.title: The Dark Knight
programme.desc: Batman must keep a balance between heroism and vigilantism to fight a criminal known as the Joker, who would plunge Gotham City into anarchy.

programme.title: The Dark Knight Rises
programme.desc: Eight years after he took the blame for Harvey Dent's death and vanished into the night, Batman is forced out of his self-imposed exile by a cunning cat burglar and a merciless terrorist called Bane.

programme.title: Superman
programme.desc: Tech billionaire Lex Luthor seizes the opportunity to get the Man of Steel out of the way for good. Will intrepid reporter Lois Lane and Superman's four-legged companion, Krypto, be able to help him before it's too late?

programme.title: Supergirl
programme.desc: Kara (Helen Slater) of Argo City poses as Clark Kent's cousin, Linda Lee, to recover the Omegahedron from a witch (Faye Dunaway).

programme.title: Supergirl
programme.desc: Kara (Helen Slater) of Argo City poses as Clark Kent's cousin, Linda Lee, to recover the Omegahedron from a witch (Faye Dunaway).

programme.title: Bury My Heart at Wounded Knee
programme.desc: U.S. government policies and westward expansion lead to tragic consequences for American Indians.

programme.title: The Unbreakable Tatiana Suarez
programme.desc: A chronicle of the MMA fighter Tatiana Suarez as she returns to the sport after an injury forced a four-year hiatus; Suarez reflects on her journey from wrestling prodigy to professional athlete in the UFC and the legacy she leaves young women.

programme.title: A Girl in the River: The Price of Forgiveness
programme.desc: A woman in Pakistan sentenced to death for falling in love becomes a rare survivor of the country's harsh judicial system.

programme.title: Plastic Disasters
programme.desc: Three case studies of plastic surgery procedures that have gone horribly wrong.

programme.title: Saving Face
programme.desc: Plastic surgeon Dr. Mohammad Jawad returns to his native Pakistan to help those left horribly scarred by acid attacks.

programme.title: Coraline
programme.desc: A girl finds a secret door in her new home and walks into an alternate reality that closely mirrors her own but, in many ways, is better.

programme.title: ParaNorman
programme.desc: A ghoul-whispering youngster (Kodi Smit-McPhee) battles zombies, ghosts, witches and ignorant adults to save his town from an ancient curse.

programme.title: Kubo and the Two Strings
programme.desc: Young Kubo leads a quiet life in a small village until a spirit from the past renews an age-old vendetta, plunging him into a search for his father's magical armor to survive.

programme.title: The Boxtrolls
programme.desc: A boy (Isaac Hempstead-Wright) and his new friend (Elle Fanning) hatch a plan to save a community of mischievous cavern-dwellers from the villainous townsman (Ben Kingsley) who plans to exterminate them.

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: Parapsychologist Elise Rainier and her team travel to Five Keys, N.M., to investigate a claim of a haunting in her childhood home. She must soon confront and destroy her greatest fear, the demon that she accidentally set free years earlier.

programme.title: Insidious: The Red Door
programme.desc: Josh Lambert heads east to drop his son, Dalton, off at school. However, Dalton's college dream soon becomes a living nightmare when the repressed demons of his past suddenly return to haunt them both.

programme.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
programme.desc: In 1986 paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren travel to Pennsylvania to vanquish a demon from a family's home.

programme.title: Backrooms
programme.desc: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom, leading to an endless network of interconnected rooms where time bends and the only thing scarier than getting lost is the sense that something is lying in wait.

programme.title: Undertone
programme.desc: The host of a popular paranormal podcast is sent hidden messages within anonymous recordings, unleashing a demonic presence that is impossible to escape.

programme.title: Ready Player One
programme.desc: In 2045, the creator of a virtual reality universe promises his fortune to the first person to discover a digital Easter egg. Soon, young Wade Watts finds himself in a reality-bending treasure hunt through the mysterious and fantastical world.

programme.title: The Drama
programme.desc: An explosive confession throws the wedding of a seemingly perfect couple off the rails as they spiral to confront whether they can truly make it to "I do."

programme.title: Enigma
programme.desc: An exploration of transgender identity and legacy through the stories of icons April Ashley and Amanda Lear.

programme.title: The Legend of the Underground
programme.desc: Uncovering discrimination in Nigeria and exploring the lives of several charismatic, non-conformist youth who must choose either to fight for freedom of expression or flee to live free. Through social media, they spark a cultural revolution.

programme.title: The Out List
programme.desc: People from the LGBTQ community discuss being "out" in America; interviews include Neil Patrick Harris, Ellen DeGeneres, Christine Quinn, Cynthia Nixon, Wade Davis and Wanda Sykes.

programme.title: Knock Knock
programme.desc: Two nubile, stranded women reveal a sinister agenda after they spend the night with a married architect.

programme.title: Tusk
programme.desc: A U.S. podcaster (Justin Long) ventures into the Canadian wilderness to interview an old man (Michael Parks) who has an extraordinary past, and the American learns the man has a dark secret involving a walrus.

programme.title: Blumhouse's Truth or Dare
programme.desc: A game of truth or dare results in fatalities when an unknown entity penalizes participants for lying or declining challenges.

programme.title: Us
programme.desc: A couple and their two children must fight for survival when four masked strangers descend upon their beachfront home. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them.

programme.title: Thanksgiving
programme.desc: A mysterious masked maniac terrorizes residents of Plymouth, Mass., one year after a Black Friday riot ended in tragedy. Picking off victims one by one, the seemingly random revenge killings soon become part of a larger, sinister plan.

programme.title: Final Destination Bloodlines
programme.desc: Plagued by a violent and recurring nightmare, a college student heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle of death and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

programme.title: The Long Walk
programme.desc: Teens participate in a grueling high-stakes contest where they must continuously walk or be shot by a member of their military escort.

programme.title: Hereditary
programme.desc: When the matriarch of the Graham family passes away, her daughter and grandchildren begin to unravel cryptic and increasingly terrifying secrets about their ancestry, trying to outrun the sinister fate they have inherited.

programme.title: The Hole in the Ground
programme.desc: One night, Sarah's young son disappears into the woods behind their rural home. When he returns, he looks the same, but his behavior grows increasingly disturbing. Sarah begins to believe that the boy who returned may not be her son at all.

programme.title: Talk to Me
programme.desc: When a group of friends discover how to conjure spirits with an embalmed hand, they become hooked on the new thrill and high-stakes party game -- until one of them goes too far and unleashes terrifying supernatural forces.

programme.title: X
programme.desc: A group of actors sets out to make an adult film in rural Texas under the noses of their reclusive hosts, but when the elderly couple catches their young guests in the act, the cast finds themselves in a desperate fight for their lives.

programme.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
programme.desc: A couple is shocked when their missing daughter is returned to them after disappearing eight years earlier. However, what should be a joyful family reunion soon turns into a living nightmare as she starts to transform into something truly horrifying.

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: A law-school grad uncovers a sinister secret about the Tennessee firm that made him an offer he couldn't refuse.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: A New Jersey man (Tom Cruise) and his two children face an epic battle for survival when hostile aliens invade Earth.

programme.title: The Departed
programme.desc: In Boston an undercover cop gains a gangland chief's trust, while a career criminal infiltrates the police force for the mob.

programme.title: Stoker
programme.desc: After the tragic death of a girl's father, an eccentric uncle comes to live with the teen (Mia Wasikowska) and her unstable mother (Nicole Kidman). Though she suspects the man has ulterior motives, she becomes increasingly infatuated with him.

programme.title: Normal
programme.desc: The new sheriff of a small town in Minnesota uncovers a dark secret while investigating a botched bank robbery.

programme.desc: Hoping for a fresh start, a young woman becomes a live-in maid for a wealthy couple who harbor sinister secrets.

programme.title: Body of Evidence
programme.desc: A lawyer (Willem Dafoe) defends a gold digger (Madonna) for murder by sex, a charge whose validity he soon sees for himself.

programme.title: The Thomas Crown Affair
programme.desc: The mastermind (Steve McQueen) of a Boston bank caper falls in love with the insurance sleuth (Faye Dunaway) on his trail.

programme.title: Leaving Las Vegas
programme.desc: Intent on drinking himself to death, a man (Nicolas Cage) who has lost everything finds solace with a Las Vegas hooker (Elisabeth Shue).

programme.title: Lenny
programme.desc: 1950s comic Lenny Bruce (Dustin Hoffman) spurs controversy with his drug use, graphic language and marriage to a stripper (Valerie Perrine).

programme.title: Hellraiser III: Hell on Earth
programme.desc: A New York TV newswoman (Terry Farrell) battles Pinhead (Doug Bradley) and the Cenobites with a World War I captain's ghost.

programme.title: Hellraiser IV - Bloodline
programme.desc: A man (Bruce Ramsay) in a space station battles evil Pinhead (Doug Bradley), as did his ancestors in 18th-century France and in 1996.

programme.title: Hellraiser 5: Inferno
programme.desc: A Los Angeles detective (Craig Sheffer) wakes to find himself in hell, and his only means of leaving is with Pinhead's (Doug Bradley) puzzle box.

programme.title: Hellraiser 6: Hellseeker
programme.desc: A shady businessman attempts to piece together the details of the car crash that killed his wife, rendered him an amnesiac, and left him in possession of a sinister puzzle box that summons monsters.

programme.title: Hellraiser VII: Deader
programme.desc: A reporter (Kari Wuhrer) investigates an underground group that can resurrect the dead, much to Pinhead's (Doug Bradley) dismay.

programme.title: Hellraiser VIII: Hellworld
programme.desc: Gamers who participate in an online role-playing game (MMORPG) are invited to a rave whose host plans to show them all the truth behind the Cenobite mythos.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers
programme.desc: A cloaked figure (Jonathan Breck) terrorizes two siblings (Gina Philips, Justin Long) after they discover mutilated bodies in a country drainpipe.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
programme.desc: A winged creature (Jonathan Breck) terrorizes basketball players, coaches and cheerleaders who have become stranded on a highway.
